assessments.title: A2 End-of-Level Diagnostic
assessments.description: Use this after all A2 lessons to identify anything the learner missed and confirm whether they are ready to begin B1.

assessments.title: B1 End-of-Level Diagnostic
assessments.description: Use this after all B1 lessons to identify any remaining gaps and confirm whether the learner is ready to begin B2.

assessments.description: Use this after all B2 lessons to identify any remaining gaps and confirm readiness for advanced independent English work.
